title: Ipswich-O 2022 Continues..
text:
After last weekend's highly successful event, the next one is on Sunday 22nd in Holywells Park - see here for full details.

Once you complete your course you'll receive a signed Ipswich-O 2022 Passport to show your achievement, & this will enable you to enter our Bridge Wood, Clare & Needham Lake Summer Series events free of charge. If you've already received a Passport at the Christchurch Park event, don't forget to bring it to Holywells to collect the second signature!
